title: Lifespan variation and premature mortality from malignant CNS neoplasms in Europe: analysis code
description:
Analysis code and derived data for a study of the effect of mortality from malignant central nervous system neoplasms (ICD-10 C70-C72) on life expectancy and life disparity across 28 European countries over the common period 2012 to 2018, and of the dependence of cross-country comparisons of years of life lost on the reference life table.

The pipeline combines Eurostat cause-of-death data with Human Mortality Database exposures, all-cause deaths and period life tables. It computes age-standardised mortality and years of life lost rates, years of life lost under national and two common reference life tables, cause-deleted life tables giving the change in life expectancy at birth and in life disparity, numerically identified threshold ages, an exactly additive age decomposition of the life-disparity effect, and percentile intervals from 10,000 Poisson resampling replicates.

Human Mortality Database source files are not redistributable and are not included; an authenticated retrieval script and a manifest of series vintages and SHA-256 digests are provided instead. RESULTS_SUMMARY.md records the design and every headline result.
